title: The thoughtful editor
description: Give your writing a sharper, more human voice.
content:
Act as an experienced editor. Improve the clarity, flow, and structure of the following text while preserving my voice. Explain the most important changes you made.

Text: [paste your text]

title: Explore an idea
description: Turn a rough thought into something worth pursuing.
content: Help me explore this idea: [describe idea]. Ask clarifying questions, identify the strongest opportunities, and suggest three distinct directions I could take it.

title: Explain it simply
description: Make complex topics easier to understand.
content: Explain [topic] to someone with no prior experience. Start with an intuitive analogy, then build toward the key details. Finish with a short example.

title: Code review partner
description: Find issues and make your code more maintainable.
content:
Review the following code for correctness, readability, security, and performance. Prioritize your findings and suggest concrete improvements.

Code: [paste code]

title: The research brief
description: Get oriented on a new subject, fast.
content: Create a concise research brief on [topic]. Cover the fundamentals, major debates, open questions, and useful directions for further reading. Clearly distinguish facts from uncertainty.

title: Find the right words
description: Write a considered message for any situation.
content: Help me write a [type of message] to [recipient]. The context is [context], and the tone should be [tone]. Give me three options with different levels of formality.
